label: CONTEXT_INDEXED_BELIEF_POOL_CLOSURE_2: Separate pools BK and BL each contain the initial g and are…
definition: Separate pools BK and BL each contain the initial g and are closed under their own K3 or LP relation, respectively. Their semantic theories of g can both reject C because no common unindexed pool or cross-profile transfer is required.
note: Strongest local pluralist/conventionalist survivor in #1084. Separate indexing is not rejected as false; the example isolates the extra shared-pool bridge. It is no complete philosophy of pluralism or theory of categorical epistemic authority.
